name: Toyo Seikan Group Holdings, Ltd.
summary: Toyo Seikan Group Holdings, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells packaging containers in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Packaging; Engineering, Filling and Logistics; Steel Plate Related; Functional Materials Related; Real Estate Related; and Other Businesses segments. The company offers various packaging containers, including metal cans and caps; PET and plastic bottles, plastic films and pouches, and plastic trays and caps; paper cups and corrugated cardboard products; and glass bottles and paper and resin tableware.
